prefix.title: Services Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix for all services. Useful if you have multiple Subaru vehicles. Example: 'Climate' becomes 'Outback Wilderness Climate'.

remoteStartPresets.title: Remote Start Preset
remoteStartPresets.description: Climate preset for remote start. Defaults to Heat if not selected.

horn.title: Horn on Remote Start
horn.description: Sound the horn when remote starting the vehicle, defaults to true

runTimeMinutes.title: Remote Start Run Time (minutes)
runTimeMinutes.description: How long the engine should run, defaults to 10 minutes

delay.title: Remote Start Delay (minutes)
delay.description: Delay before starting the engine, defaults to immediately
